purpose: Determine whether weak GOLD SHORT performance is partly caused by incomplete Mochipoyo PRIMARY_SHORT proxy fidelity before any further payoff optimization. Compare genuine XAUUSD source PRIMARY_SHORT events with matched, missed and finalized-extra proxy PRIMARY_SHORT signals using only causal M15 information available at each decision time.

scope.source: existing M7C prospective source-event comparisons and proxy decisions, read-only

groups.SOURCE_MISSED_SHORT: genuine source PRIMARY_SHORT classified MISSED or WRONG_TRANSITION_NEARBY
groups.FINALIZED_EXTRA_PROXY_SHORT: proxy PRIMARY_SHORT not matched to a source event after the frozen M7C arrival grace

features.decision_time: new M15 bar open; previous fully closed M15 only plus current M15 open exactly as frozen M7C causal contract
focus: EMA slope-related flattened features when available
current open distance from EMA20/EMA40 normalized by ATR
ATR/volatility and candle/price-position features when available

analysis.candidate_fidelity_gate_generation: descriptive simple one-feature separators only; prefer >=80% matched-source retention and rank extra-proxy rejection; no automatic kernel change

decision_policy.if_clear_missing_condition_signal: freeze only as an exploratory fidelity hypothesis, then validate prospectively in a new comparison shadow without changing M7C
decision_policy.if_no_clear_signal_or_sample_too_small: do not refit M7C; proceed to a separate Mochipoyo-independent SHORT candidate discovery stage
